comment: Mapping from the 2026-08-02 Meshy character dump to residents, CORRECTED against the visual source of truth: art/concept/characters/CHARACTER_BIBLE.md and its four cast boards. The first mapping was made from role evidence alone and misassigned nine residents; the boards settled every call. Sources live gitignored in art/blender/meshy/<source>/; convert_dump_characters.py builds each hero model at assets/characters/<slug>/<slug>.gltf. Remap and re-run the converter if the boards ever change.

teresa_vale.why: board 03: navy scrubs, badge, the night nurse

mina_vale.why: owner-designated FINAL model 2026-08-13, replacing the board-derived Futuristic_Field_Engi pick. keep_emission is deliberate and unique to her: the owner instructed that her self-illumination NOT be stripped, so she reads self-lit where every other figure receives scene light.
